role: SessionReanalysisCoordinator extension: cached ReanalysisService construction, single-session reanalysis with in-flight guard, auto-rescore NotificationCenter listener, CloudKit-pull snapshot backfill, auto-refresh of today's sleep, and thin wrappers onto ReanalysisService.

units.does: Returns collector._reanalysisService, building and caching one with the current settings as fallback on first access.

branches.effect: return it; else build and cache

units.does: Constructs ReanalysisService with the collector's archive/HealthKit/pipeline/selectors/baseline and weak-collector provider closures (settings, scoring, ANS, training context, analyze, archive-changed) plus a CloudKit force-reupload closure.
Returns a closure giving each session's ANS configuration via collector.ansConfig(for:), or the population fallback when the collector is gone.
Fallback ANS config: population baseline RMSSD, no VO2max, zero training-load adjustment.

Reanalyses one session. If one is already in flight for the id it records a pending request and returns the archived copy; otherwise marks it in flight, runs one pass (reanalyzeOnce), then one more pass for each request that arrived meanwhile (it may carry newer inputs, e.g. sleep that landed after the pass read HealthKit), and returns the latest result.

branches.effect: records it pending, returns the coalesced archived copy

branches.cond: a request arrived while in flight
branches.effect: trailing pass; its nil result keeps the previous one

units.does: One reanalysis pass over the session as it is on disk now: loads the full session, holds the session day's past training load (released afterwards), warms the training-metrics cache if cold, and runs ReanalysisService.reanalyzeSession.

When training-load integration is on and the session is not today, counts one more holder of that day's load, computes it from HealthKit into collector.pastDayTrainingLoads and returns the day key; else nil.

branches.cond: integration off or session is today

units.does: Drops one holder of a past day's training load; the last holder to finish removes the load and the count, so two reanalyses of the same day (a nap and the night) do not clear it for each other.

branches.effect: stores the reduced count, keeps the load

units.does: Logs and returns the archived copy of the session (detached retrieve), falling back to the passed-in session.
Loads the full session (with rrSeries) from the archive off-main, falling back to the input.
Refreshes the shared TrainingMetricsCache (now-anchored) only when it is empty or ATL and CTL are both 0.

branches.cond: current nil, or atl/ctl nil→0 and both 0

units.does: Writes a PendingScoreChange (banner) when both scores exist and the change is >= 3 display points (0.3 stored).
Registers a main-queue observer for .flowRecoveryRescoreNeeded whose block reads the session UUID and reason/detail and dispatches handleRescoreRequest on the main actor; stores the token for deinit.

branches.cond: collector gone or object not a UUID

units.does: Handles one rescore request: captures the prior score; reason 'training' → score-only recompute; otherwise full reanalysis, falling back to score-only recompute when it returns nil; records a pending score change and bumps the archive signal on success.
Score-only recompute when full reanalysis refused; finishes the rescore when it returns a session.
Training-only rescore via ReanalysisService.recomputeScoreOnly; finishes the rescore when it returns a session.
Records a pending score change if meaningful and bumps the archive signal.
Registers a main-queue observer for .cloudKitSnapshotBackfillNeeded that drains the backfill queue with the posted session ids; stores the token; also starts one launch-time drain with no new ids.
units.entry: Called from RRCollector init (RRCollector.swift:812); the observer block runs on CloudKitSyncManager's post.

branches.cond: collector gone, no sessionIds, or empty

units.does: Reanalyzes every archived session (decoded in full off the main actor) in the date range through ReanalysisService's reanalyzeOne overload, passing this coordinator's reanalyzeSession as the per-session pass so each night gets the past-day training load, warm cache and in-flight guard of a single Reanalyze; the service loop skips windowUserAdjusted sessions.
Forwards retro-apply of sleep settings to ReanalysisService over all archived sessions, decoded in full off the main actor.
Forwards manual-window reanalysis at a timestamp to ReanalysisService.
Forwards applying a manual analysis result to ReanalysisService.
Serialized auto-refresh of today's sleep: if one is running sets a pending flag and returns; otherwise runs performAutoRefresh repeatedly until no bump arrived during the pass.

branches.cond: repeat while pending set during the pass

units.does: Finds the newest overnight archive entry whose end (or start) is within 18 h of now and decodes it off the main actor.

branches.effect: return nil (decode errors also nil via try?)

units.does: Re-reads HealthKit sleep for today's scored overnight session; when the verdict says update, applies it to the archived copy as it is at the write (an edit saved during the fetch is kept), republishes the stored session, and when the change needs a rescore (and the stored boundaries are not user-adjusted) posts a sleep rescore request.

branches.cond: no session, no analysis, no score, or policy disallows
verdict.shouldUpdate false or the write failed

branches.effect: log and return; else post rescore

units.does: Fetches HealthKit sleep for the session window (with RR points); returns it only when it has night sleep and plausibly overlaps the recording.
On a detached task, applies the fresh sleep to the archived session in place (applyRefreshedSleep) and returns the session as stored; nil when the write failed.

Off-main: SessionArchive.update applies SleepRefreshPolicy.applyAutoRefresh to the current archived copy under the archive lock (no re-upload request: the sleep snapshot stays on the device), then re-reads it; logs and returns nil on a write error.
Replaces currentSession if it is the same id and bumps the archive signal.

Adds ids to the persisted backfill queue; unless empty or another drain runs, processes up to maxPerCycle (10) sessions, removes done ids, defers missed ones, and bumps the archive signal when any were processed.
units.entry: CloudKit snapshot backfill observer and launch drain (installCloudKitSnapshotBackfillListener).

units.does: Walks the queue, processing at most maxPerCycle sessions that still need snapshots; returns done, missed and processed count.

branches.cond: for each id while processed < maxPerCycle
session no longer needs snapshots (or unreadable)

units.does: Returns the archived session when it has no sleepSnapshot and is not user-adjusted; nil otherwise or when retrieve fails (try?).

branches.cond: retrieve fails, has sleepSnapshot, or user-adjusted

units.does: Fetches HealthKit recovery vitals at session end and substitutes strap nocturnal mean HR for resting HR.
Fetches pulled-session sleep and vitals; when either exists applies them to the stored copy via archive.update (no reupload); false when Health had nothing or the write failed.
On the stored copy: applies pulled sleep if none exists and not user-adjusted; sets vitalsSnapshot if absent and vitals non-empty.

branches.cond: sleep present, no stored snapshot, not user-adjusted

units.does: HealthKit sleep for a pulled session, gated on night sleep > 0 and plausible overlap.
Forwards sleep-boundary update to ReanalysisService.
Forwards segment unlink to ReanalysisService.
Forwards training-snapshot repair over all archived sessions, decoded in full off the main actor, to ReanalysisService.
Builds a reason string and posts .flowRecoveryRescoreNeeded with the session id and reason 'sleep' plus a detail string.
